## Review checklist

- [ ] Issue reference and acceptance criteria match this PR.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or regressions; skipped checks are explicit.
- [ ] Documentation, contracts and migration guidance match the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, private conversations or personal travel data are included.
- [ ] Release decision and release-note impact are complete.
- [ ] PR policy and Quality gates pass before merge.
